## What does your mod do?

## Checklist
- [ ] Only changes files in `mods/<my-mod>/`
- [ ] Only affects my own game (nothing sent to other players, no grief, no economy, no account data)
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_mod.py` passes
- [ ] Builds with `./build.sh` / `build.bat`
- [ ] Tested on a headset with the newest blaze APK from the Discord
